summary: D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading (Hepsiburada) filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of a planned CEO transition. Nilhan Gökçektekin stepped down as CEO effective July 1, 2026, with Ender Özgün appointed as new CEO, and Hakan Karadoğan to lead the Delivery business as CEO. The transition was first announced on December 29, 2025, and was planned jointly by the Board. The filing details the new leadership structure but provides no financial terms, advisors, or shareholder vote. The change is a routine executive succession rather than a forced departure, thus classified as Management Changes but with low event-driven impact. What to watch: execution under new leadership and any strategic shifts.
